name: Flux
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: an original ultra-high-fidelity FULL-LENGTH DESKTOP PORTFOLIO WEBPAGE screenshot, tall portrait output approximately 1536x2304. This is a wide desktop page scrolled from header through hero, four projects, capabilities, and experience, not a phone layout. Flat edge-to-edge actual webpage, not a device or browser mockup.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity reference for the engineer's portrait: preserve his recognizable face, dark swept hair, glasses, facial hair, black suit, white shirt and tie. Integrate this same person naturally into the design; do not replace with another man, a robot or an avatar. Image 2 is a CONTENT REFERENCE ONLY for the actual DSP driving-school dashboard screenshot. Use a recognizable miniature of that dashboard in the DSP project. Do not copy either reference's overall composition as the webpage layout.
Subject: Zohaib Haider, Full-Stack AI Software Engineer.
IMPORTANT PROJECT CONTENT: Exactly FOUR featured projects, clearly and correctly named, all four readable: 'OpsPilot' with caption 'AI platform'; 'HR Intelligence' with caption 'AI-powered HR'; 'DSP' with caption 'Driving school bookings + Stripe payments'; 'RTA' with caption 'Full-stack platform'. Do NOT use Daizer, CardLock, PDE, TaskFlow, or any other project names. The RTA project is not yet described so do not invent its industry or features. Other than DSP, use abstract interface design placeholders labeled 'PROJECT PREVIEW'; do not imply they are exact real screenshots. OpsPilot and HR Intelligence must clearly communicate AI in their titles and captions.
Visible capabilities: 'AI / LLM integrations', 'Payments + fintech', 'Stripe · PayPal · Webhooks', 'Zoho Books · QuickBooks', 'React · NestJS · PostgreSQL · AWS'. A concise experience band must say 'Jidat IT', 'Full-stack development', 'Feb 2024 — Present'. No years-experience counter, revenue number, fake clients, testimonials or fabricated achievements.
Overall request: an unusually stylish, original, premium personal portfolio that communicates the engineer's actual experience, with beautiful 3D art direction and clear readable content. Strong typography, exceptional spacing and meaningful project storytelling. The portrait must feel like part of the visual identity. The user specifically rejects ordinary text-left/image-right hero layouts. Use an integrated composition across the full width. Show a plausible resting frame of proposed 3D animation.
Avoid: basic two-column landing hero, generic SaaS template, repetitive bento cards, excessive badges, generic AI brain, robots, stock people, cryptocurrency coins, starfield, gaming HUD, fake metrics, watermarks. Do not let text cover the face.
Design direction FLUX: graphite-black #0B1110, luminous sea-glass #8CE3CB, restrained copper #C98A61, warm chalk #F3F1E8. A cinematic yet human portfolio about intelligent systems and money movement. Stunning layered depth, impeccable modern grotesk mixed with one expressive italic serif.
FULL PAGE COMPOSITION:
1. Top 5% slim nav 'ZH / ZOHAIB HAIDER' left, 'WORK / EXPERTISE / EXPERIENCE' center, small 'LET’S TALK ↗' right.
2. Next 30% is a spectacular full-width centered hero. Enormous typographic 'HUMAN THINKING.' across upper hero, lower typographic 'INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS.' extends across width behind the portrait shoulders. Engineer's actual portrait centrally placed as a sharp medium bust, about one-third of screen width, with full face visible, illuminated subtle teal on one side copper on the other. A gorgeous polished black-chrome architectural ribbon flows from upper-left, BEHIND his shoulders and loops out lower-right into a four-way elegant thin signal path. The ribbon is a single unique flowing geometric object, not concentric rings or a glowing orb. Small floating precise labels on path: 'AI', 'PAYMENTS', 'PRODUCTS'. A crisp small centered role just below portrait 'FULL-STACK AI SOFTWARE ENGINEER'. Tiny supporting line 'AI-driven products. Connected payments. End-to-end engineering.' below. One tasteful sea-glass square arrow CTA 'Explore the work ↗'. Plenty of dark negative space; visually magnetic portrait with no split layout.
3. Next 7% a beautifully typeset expertise rail: 'AI / LLM integrations', 'Payments + fintech', 'Accounting APIs' separated by tiny copper marks. Under it small readable integration names from shared content.
4. Next 33% FOUR selected project exhibits, in two differently proportioned editorial rows: row1 a large OpsPilot AI interface stage and narrower DSP screenshot stage; row2 a narrower HR Intelligence AI interface stage and wider RTA stage. Rich black-glass angled display surfaces with perspective depth, but crisp surrounding titles and project numbers. They should feel like four architectural exhibition plinths with unique compositions, not four identical rounded cards. All four named with exact captions. Real DSP dashboard from Image 2, other three abstract clean placeholders. Each has 'VIEW CASE STUDY ↗'. Use sea-glass workflow threads connecting subtle AI interface fragments and copper transaction paths for DSP.
5. Next 12% on slightly lighter charcoal a meaningful beautiful full-width flow 'INTERFACE → API → AI / PAYMENTS → DATA', with restrained 3D glass tiles along one signal line, small heading 'What I bring to the system'. Under it two crisp short readable lines on AI integrations and payment/accounting workflows.
6. Bottom 13% refined experience editorial strip with Jidat IT and dates, then enormous 'LET’S BUILD WHAT’S NEXT.' with email-link style contact CTA. No fake email.
Typography must be outstanding, legible, rhythmic. Hero is immersive but four projects are major content, not tiny thumbnails. The palette must harmonize with portrait. Sophisticated selective glow only, strongly controlled.
